Independent sources describe an Ann Palgrave who married Richard Palgrave in Great Yarmouth, Norfolk in 1625/26 and, after his death, married Rev. This tree record more likely represents a daughter or granddaughter of that immigrant couple (who married Thomas Biggs), with the ancestress's maiden name incorrectly carried down onto the descendant's entry. Exact descendant not identified; flagged as likely conflation rather than corrected outright.
